summary: Pilot-only nested-CV run of kernel logistic regression, writing cv_auc alone (logistic-cv milestone)
reasoning: Design frozen on pilot diagnostics alone: plain and spline-additive logistics cap at 0.63 (steps 6-7), while RBF-kernel logistic regression on the given features shows a broad, seed-stable plateau at 0.86-0.87 (steps 12-15). The analysis.py now implements L2-regularised kernel logistic regression (logistic loss/link, no engineered columns), inner 5-fold CV choosing (gamma, lam) in a 20-cell grid from pilot training data only, estimated by outer 5-fold nested CV (seed 0). Expect nested cv_auc ~0.86, safely over the 0.80 threshold; the plateau makes a drop below 0.80 unlikely. The run opens only data/pilot.csv and writes nothing but cv_auc to out/metrics.json — the same convention as the pairs trail's baseline step-9, whose 0.6313 remains my reference point.
